**Download `HoldSwitch-<version>-win-x64.zip`**, unpack and run `HoldSwitch.exe` (Windows 10/11, x64). No installation needed.

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged source. To check that the file you downloaded is exactly that build:

```
gh attestation verify HoldSwitch-<version>-win-x64.zip --repo Roman-Matus/HoldSwitch
```

The exe is not code-signed yet: if Windows shows *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway**.

The zip contains `HoldSwitch.exe`, `readme.txt` (RU), `readme_en.txt` (EN) and `LICENSE.txt`.

---

Скачайте `HoldSwitch-<версия>-win-x64.zip`, распакуйте и запустите `HoldSwitch.exe`. Файл собран GitHub Actions из исходного кода этой версии. Описание на русском — в `readme.txt` внутри архива.
